lines.say: One Deluge condition. Two different answers.
lines.show: One Deluge condition. Two different answers.

lines.say: Deluge has if, else if, and else. The first true test wins. The rest are skipped.
lines.show: Deluge has if, else if and else. The first true test wins; the rest are skipped.

lines.say: So put the narrowest test first. Or the later branches never run.
lines.show: So put the narrowest test first, or the later branches never run.

lines.say: Here's the trap. Zoho Creator works out OR before annd. Every other Zoho service works out annd first.
lines.show: The trap: Zoho Creator works out OR before AND. Every other Zoho service works out AND first.

lines.say: Put brackets round each group, and the test reads the same everywhere.
lines.show: Put brackets round each group, and the test reads the same everywhere.

lines.say: Empty is not one test. The checks is null, is blank and is empty all give different answers.
lines.show: Empty is not one test. isNull, isBlank and isEmpty all give different answers.

lines.say: For text, test is null, or is blank. That covers null, empty text and spaces.
lines.show: For text, test isNull or isBlank. That covers null, empty text and spaces.

lines.say: Need a default? Use if null. And there's no switch, so use a map lookup.
lines.show: Need a default? Use ifNull. And there's no switch, so use a map lookup.
